subject: Funding ownership & procurement plan for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sanjeev Patel <sanjeev.patel@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today’s discovery (Redwood pilot)

Hi Sanjeev — great to meet you and the OrionAI team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum.

Call recap (30 min):
- Goals: quantify inference cost and latency for your multi-tenant ingestion use case; validate data-in-transit controls.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 
  - < $0.12/1k tokens on steady state production,
  - median tail latency < 150ms for priority flows,
  - SOC2 evidence and ability to restrict models to private VPC.
- Pilot scope we discussed: 2-week sandbox, 5M tokens/day peak, 1 model variant (Llama-2-like) with KV caching.

Action items I’ve captured:
1) Please confirm the economic buyer / who signs PO for pilots.
2) Confirm procurement timeline (approx dates for PO review / legal redlines).
3) Security contacts for questionnaire + any required IP/hosting constraints.
4) If there’s an internal budget range you can share (ballpark ok), that will help us scope the pilot options.

I’ve attached a short pilot pricing workbook and a one-page security summary for your security team: redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx, redwood-security-summary.pdf.

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement & security sync next week (I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT). If you can confirm econ buyer and procurement contact, I’ll loop them into the calendar invite and the DocuSign/PO checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

--
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183
https://www.redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pilot-pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-security-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Sanjeev Patel <sanjeev.patel@orionai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Khanna <priya.khanna@orionai.com>, Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@orionai.com>, Stacey Lo <stacey.lo@orionai.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today’s discovery (Redwood pilot)

Connor — thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. A few quick answers from our side:

- Economic buyer / PO signer: Priya Khanna (Director of Data Platforms). She owns the budget for ML infra pilots.
- Procurement lead: Stacey Lo (procurement manager) will handle PO/contract logistics.
- Security / architecture contact: Michael Rossi (Head of DevOps) will take the questionnaire and confirm VPC constraints.
- Budget: we can earmark ~$18k–25k for a short pilot depending on outcomes (happy to discuss exact scope).
- Timeline: Priya is out next week but is OK with a fast-track review; Stacey suggested a 10 business-day review window for a small pilot PO.

We’re happy to run the proposed sandbox. Please put Priya, Michael, and Stacey on the invite and include the security summary and any SOC2 / encryption specifics.

Thanks — Sanjeev

"On Wed, Sep 16, 2026 at 09:04 AM, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted]
"

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Khanna <priya.khanna@orionai.com>, Stacey Lo <stacey.lo@orionai.com>, Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + proposed pilot intake steps (Redwood <> OrionAI)

Hi Priya / Stacey / Michael — thanks Sanjeev for the intros. Looping you in to get the pilot intake moving. Quick suggested intake plan:

1) Security checklist: Michael — can your team confirm the drive link I shared has what you need? If not, we can run a quick 30-min tech review to walk through VPC and encryption.
2) Pilot SOW & pricing: Ben (cc) will draft a one-page SOW with the 2-week sandbox scope at the mid-range budget Sanjeev called out.
3) PO & legal: Stacey — if you can share the purchase order template or any required contractual clauses, we’ll prepare a short form order and a DocuSign to speed approval.
4) Economic approval: Priya — is there anyone else you want included in budget sign-off? If the $18k–25k range is feasible we can scope to the lower end and add optional items as add-ons.

Proposed times for the technical review (Michael + Monica + our eng lead): Tue 9/21 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 9/22 8:00–8:30 PT. Let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Connor

--
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Khanna <priya.khanna@orionai.com>, Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@orionai.com>, Stacey Lo <stacey.lo@orionai.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed pilot intake steps (Redwood <> OrionAI)

Thanks for the intro — happy to run the tech review. A couple of quick asks so we’re efficient on the call:
- Michael: can you confirm whether OrionAI requires a dedicated VPC peering or if IP allowlist to our hosted environment suffices?
- Please share any mandatory encryption-at-rest KMS info or HSM requirements ahead of the call.
- If you have an internal security questionnaire (1–2 pages), send it over and I’ll pre-fill the parts we can.

I’ll bring our solutions engineer (remote) to the tech review and we’ll come prepared to demo the KV cache behavior and expected latencies for your throughput profile. Once we align on security/hosting constraints we’ll finalize the SOW and pricing worksheet.

Monica
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Quoted text included above as requested.
